main_topics.reason: The user came to understand their cancer risk and asked what factors raise or lower it, including how left-sided disease and stable inflammation affect the picture.
The user asked when monitoring should start, how often it should happen, and whether the procedure differs from a routine colonoscopy.
The user asked whether mesalamine affects cancer risk and said they sometimes wonder whether they still need it when feeling well.
The user asked whether lifestyle could affect risk and received guidance on several general measures.

output.summary: The user, who has had stable left-sided ulcerative colitis for about nine years while taking mesalamine, wanted a clearer understanding of colorectal cancer risk and surveillance. The assistant explained risk factors, colonoscopy timing and intervals, surveillance technique, and mesalamine and lifestyle considerations; the user said they felt better equipped to speak with their gastroenterologist.
